trace.name: commute
trace.text:
On the way to work

A clean, invigorating autumn breeze sweeps off the bay. You listen to an engaging science podcast that makes the twenty-minute walk feel effortless.

You arrive at the warehouse gate feeling awake and mentally clear.

Arrive at work

trace.name: work
trace.text:
Your shift

Diesel exhaust wafts into Bay 2 as an idling flatbed rumbles outside. A senior dispatcher curses over the PA system about missed delivery windows. A persistent headache pounds behind your temples.

The breakroom microwave hums with the scent of reheated soup. The vending machine swallows a crumpled dollar bill without dispensing pretzels. You sit on a hard plastic chair, massaging your cramped calves until the buzzer rings.

Complete shift
